exports.name: init
exports.desc: 幂等预烘焙离屏 9-slice 面板、4×4 按钮与像素精灵，未手调时自动懒初始化

exports.name: drawPanel
exports.signature: drawPanel(ctx, x, y, w, h, variant='wood', opts={})
exports.desc: 支持 wood / parchment / stone / tooltip / bar 五套平铺九宫格容器与 accentColor / highlight / alpha

exports.name: drawButton
exports.signature: drawButton(ctx, x, y, w, h, label, state={})
exports.desc: 支持 primary / secondary / danger / ghost 四风格与常态 / 悬停 / 按下 / 禁用四态立体像素按钮

exports.name: drawHeart
exports.desc: 16×16 手绘像素红心，支持满心(1)、半心(0.5)、石槽空心(0)

exports.name: drawCoin
exports.desc: 16×16 锻打黄铜像素金币徽记

exports.name: drawHpBar
exports.signature: drawHpBar(ctx, cx, y, w, hp, maxHp, bar, barsTotal)
exports.desc: 青铜像素槽多段血条、叠层晶格指示与顶部纯数字血量读数

exports.name: drawShield
exports.signature: drawShield(ctx, cx, y, shield, shieldMax, broken)
exports.desc: 红绿蓝三色棱面护盾晶格、碎裂暗槽与破盾青色像素签

exports.name: drawCountdown
exports.signature: drawCountdown(ctx, cx, cy, n, t, danger)
exports.desc: 青铜/警示朱红像素圆章，含无模糊阶梯脉冲外圈与像素数字

exports.name: drawColorRing
exports.signature: drawColorRing(ctx, cx, cy, r, collectedMask, cursor, t)
exports.desc: 六色青铜法环底座、切面宝石镶孔、白晶核心、旋转金框指针与集色读数

exports.name: drawGemLevelBar
exports.signature: drawGemLevelBar(ctx, x, y, w, channelIdx, level, exp, maxExp)
exports.desc: 红绿蓝多面体像素小宝石、级数标签与镶边进度槽

exports.name: drawPixelNumber
exports.desc: 手工 5×7 点阵像素字体，支持硬描边、暴击金橙梯度(crit)与逐字七彩(rainbow)
